scripts.build: npm run build -w @doldskrift/core && npm run build -w @doldskrift/web && npm run build -w @doldskrift/react && npm run build -w doldskrift-site
scripts.check: cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace && npm test
scripts.site:preview: npm run build -w doldskrift-site && npm run preview -w doldskrift-site
